name: Alice: Time Rift

features.name: Sticky Respins
features.description: Scatters and wilds lock symbols in place.

features.name: Random bonus modifiers
features.description: The bonus starts with a random boost.

review:
Wonderland gone dark and steampunk, on a 3x5 grid with 10 paylines. Scatters and wilds trigger sticky respins that lock symbols in place, building up wins and pushing you closer to the bonus.

High volatility, 7,500x cap. The published RTP is 94.10%, so it returns less on average than plenty of slots. The look is great; just go in knowing the numbers.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
